name: popover
need: Show a small form, a share box or details next to the control that opened it, without leaving the page

--ds-popover-width.description: the widest a popover gets (it is as wide as its content up to this)

--ds-popover-tip-width.description: the widest a `.ds-popover--tip` help card gets

--ds-popover-padding.description: the padding of a popover's parts at the comfortable density

--ds-popover-tip-padding.description: the padding of a `.ds-popover--tip` help card's parts at the comfortable density

--ds-popover-radius.description: the popover's radius at the default shape

physical..ds-popover--arrow::before: left: script coordinate: --ds-popover-arrow runs from the box's left edge
physical..ds-popover--arrow:is([data-placement=\": clears the script coordinate of the block sides; the inline sides place the arrow by inset-inline
